biological_replicate.evidence: Four biological replicates per drug treatment of pharmacologically activated HEK293DAX and Fv2e-PERK were measured with DIA LC-MS/MS analysis.

For MS acquisition comparison, identical pharmacologically activated HEK293DAX and Fv2e-PERK cell lysates measured by DIA-MS were prepared as a single 18-plex for TMT-DDA analysis containing three biological replicates per each drug treatment
A total of four biological replicates were prepared for each cell line, with and without drug treatment at both time points, resulting in 64 total samples.
